caseNameFull: United States v. Rubin, Secretary of the Treasury

opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. Motion of the Independent *913Counsel for leave to file an unredaeted petition and appendix under seal granted. Leave is granted the Solicitor General to file an unredaeted response under seal to the petition. Motion for an expedited response and for an expedited briefing and argument schedule denied. Certiorari before judgment denied -without prejudice. It is assumed that the Court of Appeals will proceed expeditiously to decide this case.
